verdict.rationale: Automatic model routing is a fair question for an agent-native development platform like Factory, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions model selection, routing, or automatic choice of an underlying model per task. Personal session defaults (factory-docs-25) are an adjacent setting, not automatic routing, and earn no credit.
